extracted.intended_audience: federal regulators, government legislative drafters, lawyers, and stakeholders interested in Canadian statutory instruments and regulatory publication
extracted.subtask_description: Extracting and applying the rules and procedural standards set out in the Statutory Instruments Act (R.S.C., 1985, c. S-22) governing the creation, registration, publication, scrutiny, and access to federal statutory instruments in Canada.
